title: Junk
text: Junk. I purchased three sets (one for my travel bag, one for the house and one as a spare). The cork remover does not work at all, nor does the vacuum stopper. The stopper will seal a bottle when used like a regular stopper, but will not pump. I am disappointed, of course, and they can be returned. Fortunately I have a cork remover that does work that I purchased about seven years ago, Do yourself a favor and pass this one up.
